description: A two-party tip vault for Bitcoin Cash. A funder locks satoshis behind a secret (SHA-256 hashlock) for a beneficiary: the beneficiary claims by revealing the secret and signing, and the funder can refund after a block-height timeout if the secret is never revealed. Built for EmberTip payment pages (BCH BLAZE 2026, Build With XO bounty).

claimVaultInput.name: Vault claim

refundVaultInput.description: Spends the vault as a refund to the funder after the refund height.
refundVaultInput.name: Vault refund

scripts.vaultRedeemBytecode: OP_IF OP_SHA256 <$(<vaultSecret> OP_SHA256)> OP_EQUALVERIFY <beneficiaryKey.public_key> OP_CHECKSIG OP_ELSE <refundHeight> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP <funderKey.public_key> OP_CHECKSIG OP_ENDIF
